PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 742
ORDINANCE XVIII OF 2021
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2021
An Ordinance to amend the Lahore Development
Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
13th April, 2021]
No.Legis:13-37/2013,
dated 13.4.2021.---The following
Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
Information:
It
is expedient to amend the Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975 (XXX of 1975)
for the purpose of confining the jurisdiction of Lahore Development Authority
to Metropolitan area of Lahore, and for the ancillary matter.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be cited as the Lahore Development Authority (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of Preamble
